reason: Both refused the DIY regas up front, but Conversation 1 ran an efficient, logical sequence (rule out defrost ice, rule out evaporator fan, then conclude sealed-system fault) and reached an honest 'refrigeration engineer' escalation in three turns, citing F-Gas rules and flammable gas. Conversation 2 was repetitive and non-responsive: it kept pushing vents/seals checks even after the customer reported no frost, a warm back wall, a running fan and an oily mark, misread the knife-defrosting admission as a liner/seal issue rather than a likely evaporator puncture, and ignored the R600a rating-plate information without any flammability warning. Conversation 2 did at least address age-vs-value and recommend replacement, which Conversation 1 omitted, but its looping canned advice and failure to act on contradicting evidence outweigh that.
